relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine is a highly potent NaV1.8 inhibitor (IC50 = 0.7 nM) with approximately 31,000-fold selectivity over other NaV channels [7,27,94].

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: These studies revealed that suzetrigine binds to the extracellular loop of the S3–S4 region in the second voltage-sensing domain of NaV1.8 (VSD2), distant from the pore domain, indicating an allosteric channel inhibition [6,50,79,81].

relationships.subject: CYP3A
relationships.evidence_quote: The primary pathway for the metabolism of suzetrigine is mediated by the cytochrome P450-dependent enzyme CYP3A.

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine also works as a CYP450 enzyme inducer on CYP3A and to a lesser extent on CYP2B6 and CYP2C8/9/19.

key_findings: Suzetrigine, approved by the FDA in 2025, is the first oral selective NaV1.8 inhibitor for acute pain, binding allosterically to VSD2.
Suzetrigine has about 31,000-fold selectivity for NaV1.8 over other NaV channels including NaV1.7, and is metabolized mainly by CYP3A.
